orange.suggestion: Refreshing and full of vitamin C.

papaya.suggestion: Rich in vitamin A and good for digestion.

pineapple.suggestion: Great for digestion, has bromelain enzyme.

strawberry.suggestion: High in vitamin C and antioxidants.

blueberry.suggestion: Brain food with lots of antioxidants.

rice.suggestion: Add veggies to make it balanced.

idli.suggestion: Light and healthy south Indian option.

poha.suggestion: Light breakfast; pair with peanuts or veggies.

biriyani.suggestion: Tasty but high in fat—try homemade versions.

khichdi.suggestion: A balanced and comforting one-pot meal.

rajma.suggestion: Nutritious and filling when paired with rice.

palak paneer.suggestion: Spinach is great; watch paneer portion.

paneer butter masala.suggestion: Tasty but rich—enjoy in small amounts.

chole.suggestion: Protein-packed; pair with roti for balance.

sambar.suggestion: Low-calorie, rich in veggies and lentils.

omelette.suggestion: Add vegetables for a better mix.

scrambled eggs.suggestion: Use less oil for a healthier version.

fried chicken.suggestion: Tasty but high in fat—eat occasionally.

coffee.suggestion: Skip sugar or cream to keep it healthy.

fruit juice.suggestion: Fresh is best; avoid added sugar.

smoothie.suggestion: Healthy if made without added sugar.

burger.suggestion: Try lean meat or veggie patty options.

pasta.suggestion: Add veggies and use less cheese.

noodles.suggestion: Avoid instant noodles; go for stir-fry versions.

chocolate.suggestion: Dark chocolate is better than milk.

cake.suggestion: High sugar and fat—moderation is key.

bread.suggestion: Whole grain is a better choice.
